issue.title: Add Translation Questions Section to Resources Tab
issue.body: This ticket builds the Translation Questions section of the Resources tab, positioned below Translation Notes. It covers the accordion-style question/answer display and the section's own error/retry handling when its content fails to load. ## Functional Requirements ### Translation Questions Section - Display uW Translation Questions for the active unit below the Translation Notes section. - Make the section itself a top-level accordion (li:chevron-down), collapsed by default, that the translator taps to reveal its contents. - Label the section "Translation Questions", with a comment/question-mark icon (li:message-circle-question-mark) to the left of the title. - Show each question in an accordion (li:chevron-down) with its answer hidden until tapped. - Hide the section entirely when no Translation Questions are available for the unit. ### Error Handling - Show an inline error with a Retry button scoped to the Translation Questions section if its content fails to load. - Don't let a Translation Questions load failure block the Translation Notes or Images & Maps sections from displaying. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) Show uW Translation Questions below Notes: section accordion with nested question accordions (answer revealed on expand), hide when empty, isolated error/retry. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Mirror #189 section architecture (`TranslationQuestionsSection`) for consistency (shared accordion primitives if useful — only if a second caller exists or ticket asks; otherwise copy the #189 pattern). 2. Local query by active unit; Q/A pairs; answers hidden until question accordion opens. 3. Position below Notes in `ResourcesTab` composition order. 4. Independent load/error path from Notes and Images. ### Systems / modules / anchors - Same host/context as #189 - No TQ schema/API on `main` today — shared data layer / fluent-api dependency - Offline: #192 / #201 ### Implementation steps 1. Lock TQ model + query key with Notes data layer. 2. Section UI + nested Q→A accordions; defaults collapsed. 3. Hide when empty; error+retry isolation. 4. Tests parallel to #189. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** #188 host; ideally #189 patterns landed first for UI consistency (not a hard product blocker). Data layer / #192 for offline. - **External:** fluent-api TQ payloads — mention only. ### Edge cases & failure states - Question without answer: show question; empty answer state vs hide — **assumption:** show question with empty/missing answer handled gracefully. - Stale unit responses ignored. - Empty list → hide section. ### Testing & verification - Component tests: order below Notes, hide empty, error isolation, answer hidden until expand. - Manual Android accordion behavior. - CI gates as usual. ### Analytics / observability / migrations - Same as #189 if tables are shared; avoid duplicate schemas. ### Assumptions - Icon `li:message-circle-question-mark` maps to an available vector icon; substitute closest Ionicons/Lucide equivalent if needed without changing label. ### Open questions 1. TQ API shape (one resource file per chapter vs per verse)? 2. Should unanswered/missing answers count as “available” for section visibility? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Translation Questions section renders below Translation Notes when questions exist. - [ ] Top-level accordion, collapsed by default, labeled “Translation Questions” with question icon. - [ ] Each question is an accordion; answer hidden until expanded. - [ ] Section hidden when none available. - [ ] Section-scoped error + Retry; does not block Notes or Images & Maps. - [ ] Tests cover visibility, defaults, and error isolation.

## API readiness note (board audit — refreshed)

**Why the API is not complete for this ticket**

Translation Questions need structured Q/A payloads for the active unit. fluent-api `main` still has **no TQ domain, schema, or routes**. Mobile can discover Aquifer `UWTranslationQuestions` during Prepare Offline manifest build, but the Resources tab still uses **mock** TQ content.

### What exists today (fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb`)

- Domains: languages, bibles, projects, chapter-assignments, translated-verses, pericopes, USFM, AI, … — **no TQ**.
- Mobile Aquifer client can search `ResourceCollectionCode=UWTranslationQuestions` and fetch resource details for offline download (#295).
- Resources TQ section: mock accordion data only.

### What is missing

1. fluent-api TQ (or generic resources) API returning question/answer pairs keyed by book/chapter/verse (or unit) — **or** explicit waiver that Aquifer JSON shapes are the contract.
2. Normalized Q/A model for mobile (nested accordion) including empty-answer behavior.
3. Inventory-backed read path for Resources (#192) after download.

### What needs to be done

1. API/product: choose Aquifer-direct vs fluent-api proxy; if proxy, ship routes + caching.
2. Document TQ payload shape (per chapter file vs per verse) — still an open question on the ticket.
3. Mobile #190: replace mocks; hide when empty; isolate error/retry; prefer local inventory when #192 lands.

Checked against fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb` (2026-08-06). Prior audit was `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).
